description: This Java class `SelfServiceUserAuthorizationManager` implements an authorization manager for handling access decisions based on user roles and request paths, specifically for self-service endpoints in the Apache Fineract project. It checks if users are allowed to access certain URL paths based on whether they are marked as self-service users, and whether the request is targeting self-service features.

classes.name: SelfServiceUserAuthorizationManager
classes.description: Implements Spring Security's AuthorizationManager to enforce access control rules based on request URLs and user roles.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Determines whether the incoming request should be authorized based on user role and request URL pattern.

methods.name: selfServiceUserAuthManager
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of SelfServiceUserAuthorizationManager.
